english.note: Use 簽約 when the parties formally make an agreement by signing a contract.
Use this for signing a contractual deal, with a team or record label, or engaging a player or performer under contract.

examples.english: We will contract with a new supplier next month.
examples.traditional: 我哋下個月同新供應商簽約。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 tung4 san1 gung1 jing3 soeng1 cim1 joek3

examples.english: The team is finally going to sign him.
examples.traditional: 支球隊終於要同佢簽約喇。
examples.jyutping: zi1 kau4 deoi6 zung1 jyu1 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 cim1 joek3 laa3
